_comment: Declarative preference overrides, merged after profile/user.js by
bin/omarchy-thunderbird-apply. Keys here win over the base user.js (last write
wins in the generated file), so this is the place for machine- or user-specific
prefs without editing the shipped user.js.
Values are JSON: true/false, numbers, or strings.
Only prefs whose value DIFFERS from Thunderbird's built-in default belong here: a
pref set equal to its default is dropped from prefs.js and does nothing. A unit
test cross-checks every entry against the installed Thunderbird's defaults.
